local.kubeconfigNotice: This shell's profile may override KUBECONFIG. Sextant sets it to this cluster, but a KUBECONFIG exported in the profile wins: check kubectl config current-context before changing anything.
local.openedWithCommand: Opened in a terminal tab below; press Enter there to run it.

node.confirm: Sextant will create a privileged pod on node {{node}} in kube-system. It is deleted when you close the shell.
node.label: Shell on node {{node}}
node.starting: Starting a privileged pod on node {{node}}…

debug.title: Debug pod {{pod}}
debug.targetHint: The debug container sees the processes of this container (shared process namespace).
debug.ephemeral: An ephemeral container in this pod
debug.ephemeralHint: Needs permission to update pods/ephemeralcontainers. An ephemeral container cannot be removed: it stays in the pod (stopped) until the pod is deleted.
debug.copyHint: Sextant creates a copy of {{pod}} in {{namespace}} (no labels, so no Service sends traffic to it) and deletes it when you close the tab.
debug.command: Command of the container in the copy
debug.commandHint: Replaces the container's command and arguments in the copy, e.g. to keep a crashing container running. Empty keeps them.
debug.commandNeedsTarget: Choose the container whose command to replace.
debug.label: Debug container of {{pod}}
debug.startingCopy: Starting a copy of {{pod}} with a debug container ({{image}})…
debug.reconnectEphemeral: Reconnecting adds another ephemeral container ({{image}}) to pod {{pod}}. Ephemeral containers cannot be removed: it stays in the pod until the pod is deleted.
debug.reconnectCopy: Reconnecting creates a new copy of pod {{pod}} with a debug container ({{image}}). It is deleted when you close the tab.

files.title: Files of {{pod}}/{{container}}
files.downloadPath: Download a file or folder from the container
files.downloadHint: A file is saved as it is; a folder as a .tar.gz archive. The container needs tar.
files.upload: Upload a file into the container
files.confirm: {{file}} will be written to {{path}} in container {{container}} of pod {{pod}}. A file already there is replaced. This changes the running container, and a cancelled or failed upload can leave a partly written file there.
files.symlink: {{path}} is a symbolic link to {{target}}: download the path it points to.
files.notAFile: {{path}} is neither a file nor a folder.
files.cancelledUpload: The upload was cancelled. The file in the container may be partly written.
files.partialUpload: The file in the container may be partly written.

choice.same: The same as the current pane

panes.noPods: No running pods in this namespace.
